svg.aria-label: Espressionism architecture: the chat sends questions to POST /api/chat, which prompts Gemini directly and streams back text plus product cards built by its tools (store search, show_machines, show_store_link) from the shared store data. Cards open the store pages in a new tab. In-browser agents use the same store search through WebMCP.
svg.text: A UI and an agent, one source of truth: both read the same demo store.
